title: Can the $L^1$-$L^\infty$ duality be restored for non-dominated families of probability measures?
summary: The duality $L^{\infty}\simeq (L^{1})'$ frequently breaks down in the presence of model uncertainty, where a single reference measure $P$ is replaced by a non-dominated family of probability measures $\mathcal{P}$. The unavailability of classical measure-theoretic and functional-analytic tools in this regime poses a significant obstacle to developing robust probabilistic frameworks.
